purpose: Quantify whether unchanged B02/F05 trades amplify portfolio loss and drawdown through temporal clustering, concurrent exposure, directional overlap, drawdown additions, session loss chains and shock-adjacent concentration.

source_authority.timestamp_precision: 15-minute canonical observation grid; original Entry/Exit timestamps retained
source_authority.shock_common_contract: causal completed/open M15 movement state across all four folds; not represented as raw Tick authority

novelty_and_duplicate_audit.HYP_006_boundary: Static F05 overlap/ordinal admission thresholds B1-B3 are closed and are not rescanned. Simple caps are retained only as user-mandated counterfactual baselines.
novelty_and_duplicate_audit.HYP_009_boundary: State-adaptive F05 recovery exit is closed; this study neither changes exits nor reuses its candidate.
novelty_and_duplicate_audit.Impact_Atlas_boundary: Impact Atlas supplied only an upper-bound prioritization; this study performs dedicated event-ledger and implementable-counterfactual analysis.
novelty_and_duplicate_audit.new_falsifiable_claim: At least one simple exposure-control family can reduce maximum drawdown across folds while preserving most winner profit; failure is recorded if DD reduction is not portable or winner damage dominates.

portfolio_event_contract.A_standalone_trade: No open position at Entry and no other Entry within the primary 60-minute connected-event gap.
portfolio_event_contract.B_concurrent_exposure: At least one earlier accepted baseline trade remains open at Entry.
portfolio_event_contract.C_same_direction_overlap: At least one open position has the same side at Entry.
portfolio_event_contract.D_opposite_direction_overlap: At least one open position has the opposite side at Entry.
portfolio_event_contract.E_B02_F05_overlap: At least one position from the other strategy remains open at Entry.
portfolio_event_contract.G_loss_cluster: Two or more losing trades whose close times are connected within 60 minutes; 15/30-minute sensitivity is reported.
portfolio_event_contract.H_drawdown_add_event: A new Entry while realized portfolio equity is below its prior realized peak.
portfolio_event_contract.I_session_loss_chain: Consecutive losses within the same UTC session key, reset at the next winner or session boundary.
portfolio_event_contract.J_shock_adjacent_cluster: Entry in causal M15 shock or post-shock state under the frozen common four-fold movement contract.
portfolio_event_contract.K_recovery_interference: A new Entry while at least one existing position remains open and aggregate open-position M15 mark-to-market is negative or recovering from a deeper adverse mark.
portfolio_event_contract.shock_rule: absolute M15 open-to-open movement >= max(15 pips, trailing-96-bar 95th percentile, 4x trailing median); post-shock through 60 minutes

candidate_grid.oracle: PERFECT_LOSS_CLUSTER_AVOIDANCE_ORACLE is reported separately and cannot be ranked as implementable

evaluation_contract.selection_diagnostic: leave-one-fold-out; train selection requires winner retention >= 90% and positive realized DD reduction, then ranks DD reduction, net improvement and simplicity

stop_rules: Do not inspect or use 2025 outcomes.
Do not execute MT4 or modify Core.
Do not expand the 27-candidate grid after observing outcomes.
Do not convert an oracle upper bound into an implementable claim.
Do not recommend any family that relies on pooled results while failing fold winner-damage or DD portability.
